title: Supersede Notebook 13 Colab Scaffold with Ordered Chunked Version
trigger: User reported that Notebook 13 would not run in Colab, was not in executable order, may be too large, crashed several times, and lost data.
observed_failure_modes: Colab path mismatch for Notebook 12 zip
runtime reset cleared imports and variables
cell order sensitivity caused missing function and missing DataFrame names
incorrect SystemConfig mapping referenced absent Notebook 12 columns such as target_phase
all-at-once processing lost progress after crash
corrective_design: single bootstrap cell for imports, paths, graph reconstruction, and invariant functions
Notebook 12 row mapping restricted to actual columns
aggregation from persisted chunks instead of relying on live memory

claim_humility_review.bounded_statement: This patch explains and repairs a notebook execution scaffold. It does not report Notebook 13 scientific results or promote any topology-governance claim.
